name: Teddy Brown
source:
He is the former second-in-command of the Grobanner family reconnaissance team. He was trusted by his subordinates because of his strong sense of justice, honest hard work, and cheerful personality.

However, for some reason, he became a butler at the mansion. He is a swordsman geek and compiles information on strong swordsmen and interviews them.

[Translated from [url=https://www.devilbutler.com/%E3%83%86%E3%83%87%E3%82%A3]official website[/url]]
